items.title: Johnson Leads Eagles to Big Win Over Marshall
items.summary: STATESBORO — Georgia Southern (5-4, 4-1) defeated 49-13 Marshall (5-4, 2-3) on Saturday at Allen E. Paulson Stadium, highlighted by 35 unanswered points across five scoring drives.

items.title: The Extra Down: Built on Belief David Mbadinga's Journey From Walk-On to Leader
items.summary: Fourth-year running back David Mbadinga has never been short on belief. Long before earning opportunities in the Georgia Southern backfield or envisioning a future in software engineering, Mbadinga had to learn the value of patience and perseverance.

items.title: GAME PREVIEW: Eagles Looking to Carry Momentum Against Herd
items.summary: STATESBORO - It's Homecoming in Statesboro as the Georgia Southern football squad hosts Marshall at Allen E. Paulson Stadium in Sun Belt Conference action.

items.title: Bryant Honored By Sun Belt Once Again
items.summary: NEW ORLEANS - Georgia Southern kicker Trpp Bryant was honored by the Sun Belt Conference on Monday for his play against App State.

items.title: Eagles Run Streak Against App to Four in 19-3 Win
items.summary: STATESBORO — Georgia Southern (4-4, 3-1) defeated App State (5-3, 2-2) 19-3 on Saturday at Allen E. Paulson Stadium.

items.title: The Extra Down: Eli Anders Unexpected Path to No. 97
items.summary: A four-game football suspension during his senior year of high school helped set Georgia Southern defensive lineman Eli Anders on a path he never expected to take.

items.title: GAME PREVIEW: Old Rivals Renew Acquaintances Saturday
items.summary: STATESBORO - Old rivals renew acquaintances Saturday night as Georgia State and App State face off in Allen E. Paulson Stadium  in Sun Belt Conference action.

items.title: From Player to Coach: Darius Safford’s Journey Comes Full Circle Against App State
items.summary: When Darius Safford transferred to Georgia Southern in 2013, he quickly learned that the rivalry with App State was about more than football. Known as "Deeper Than Hate," the rivalry would become a defining part of his time as an Eagle, shaping his perspective on the program and fueling a coaching journey that has brought him back to Statesboro in a leadership role.

items.title: Rivalry Showdown Set for Halloween Night at Paulson Stadium
items.summary: STATESBORO, Ga. – Georgia Southern Athletics is preparing for a special Halloween Saturday as the Eagles welcome rival App State to Allen E. Paulson Stadium/Evans Family Field on Oct. 31 at 6:30 p.m.
